whatChanged: NEW: Nelson Peltz's Trian Fund Management is preparing a bid to take Wendy's private, backed by BlueFive Capital and franchisee Flynn Group, the FT reports (wen-trian-takeover-bid)
NEW: Curaleaf takes an unsolicited US$4.00-a-share take-over bid for Aurora Cannabis (~US$272m, a 45% premium to the 30-day VWAP) directly to shareholders (acb-curaleaf-takeover-bid)
NEW: Bank of America agrees to acquire up to 49.9% of Jio Financial Services' lending arm Jio Credit for up to INR18,268 crore (~$2.1bn) (jiofin-bofa-jio-credit-jv)

themes.label: UK-listed franchises broken up or taken private
themes.note: The London market keeps losing control of its own constituents to overseas and private capital, from the FTSE 100 down into the FTSE 250's industrials. Bodycote, the largest independent thermal-processing network in the West, has twin cash approaches a penny apart -- CVC at up to 915p (boy-cvc-takeover-bid) and Veritas Capital at up to 914p (boy-veritas-takeover-bid) -- with the board prepared to recommend either before the 2 September Rule 2.6 deadline, and the shares trading above both proposals in expectation of more. Above it, Apollo's 715p-a-share, GBP5.7bn cash offer for easyJet is firm and board-recommended after Castlelake walked away (ezj-apollo-takeover), and Prologis has a recommended Rule 2.7 offer valuing Segro at ~GBP14.3bn that would remove one of the FTSE 100's largest REITs from the LSE (pld-sgro-takeover-bid).

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsor-, sovereign- and strategic-led buyouts keep pulling listed names off public markets, and the newest bidder is a company's own largest shareholder: Trian is assembling BlueFive Capital and franchisee Flynn Group behind a take-private of Wendy's (wen-trian-takeover-bid). Already signed: Bernhard Capital's $43-a-share take-private of engineering consultancy Bowman (bwmn-bernhard-capital-takeover), Blackstone Infrastructure's Safe Harbor buying MarineMax at $53 a share (hzo-safe-harbor-acquisition), Nielsen's $13.60-a-share deal for DoubleVerify (dv-nielsen-acquisition), Apollo's firm easyJet offer (ezj-apollo-takeover), KKR's $127-a-share agreement for Integer Holdings (itgr-kkr-takeover) and the completed $55bn PIF-Silver Lake-Affinity buyout of EA (ea-pif-consortium-take-private). Still unresolved: CVC and Veritas Capital are running competing GBP1.56bn proposals for Bodycote to a 2 September deadline (boy-cvc-takeover-bid, boy-veritas-takeover-bid), Grant Thornton and New Mountain Capital's $5bn deal for CBIZ runs a go-shop to August 27 (cbz-grant-thornton-acquisition), Pacific Equity Partners' SG Fleet vehicle bids A$3.60 a share for FleetPartners (fpr-sgfleet-takeover-bid), Steel Partners' $16.75-a-share bid for InMode is fought through both the Haifa court and the AGM ballot (inmd-steel-partners-buyout), EQT keeps raising for Perpetual and keeps being rejected (ppt-eqt-takeover-bid), Frasers Group's EUR38-a-share tender for Hugo Boss closes its additional acceptance period on August 13 (boss-frasers-takeover-offer), Sazerac's ~$15bn approach for Brown-Forman has been rejected (bfb-sazerac-takeover-bid), Curaleaf has gone straight to Aurora Cannabis shareholders with a US$4.00-a-share hostile bid (acb-curaleaf-takeover-bid), and ADW Capital's $18-a-share proposal for Driven Brands was dismissed as lacking a credible basis (drvn-adw-capital-takeover-bid).

themes.label: AI data-center capacity and power build-out
themes.note: Capital keeps pouring into the physical layer of AI compute, and how it gets funded is now the story: NVIDIA has signed MOUs with six of the largest private-capital pools to mobilise over $500bn of third-party financing for the buildout across its ecosystem (nvda-compute-financing-platforms), Intel is selling $15bn of new stock to fund fab capex (intc-equity-offering-2026) and Amazon's 2026 capex guide is up to ~$220bn with capacity constrained into 2027 (amzn-capex-raise-2026). On the physical side Williams is paying up to $5.5bn for Momentum Midstream to connect Haynesville gas to Gulf Coast LNG and power demand (wmb-momentum-midstream-acquisition), Prysmian pays ~$3.8bn for Atkore's conduit and cable-management business (atkr-prysmian-acquisition) and Everus bought modular electrical specialist Epsilon Industries (ecg-epsilon-acquisition). At the compute layer, Nvidia is in talks to backstop ~$250bn of financing for OpenAI's 10GW Ohio campus (nvda-openai-datacenter-backstop), has an equity-plus-Vera-Rubin pact with Safe Superintelligence (nvda-ssi-partnership), is scaling the $10bn Naver AI factory to 200MW with Brookfield capital (naver-nvda-ai-factory-partnership), and will co-design orbital compute payloads with SpaceX (spcx-nvda-starmind-partnership). Orange and Morrison are building a EUR3bn, 400MW French JV (ora-morrison-datacenter-jv), Verizon signed a $1bn dark-fiber deal with Google (vz-google-fiber-partnership), Samsung agreed a ~$200bn memory and foundry MOU with Broadcom (samsungelec-avgo-chip-partnership), SK hynix has a long-term HBM pact with NVIDIA (skhynix-nvda-ai-partnership), Sony and TSMC are putting JPY747bn into a Kumamoto image-sensor fab (sony-tsmc-image-sensor-jv), and Doosan took control of Korea's sole wafer maker SK Siltron (doosan-sksiltron-acquisition).

themes.label: Chipmakers funding or locking in the customers that buy their chips
themes.note: Vendor financing and exclusivity remain the standard shape of frontier-AI deals, and the model is now institutionalised: NVIDIA's six-firm compute-financing platforms are designed to lend against its own GPUs so labs, enterprises and clouds can afford to buy them, syndicating the credit risk to Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR rather than carrying it in-house (nvda-compute-financing-platforms). The direct-exposure versions continue alongside: Nvidia is in talks to guarantee ~$250bn of lease and debt financing for OpenAI's Ohio campus (nvda-openai-datacenter-backstop), took a reported ~$5bn equity stake in pre-revenue Safe Superintelligence alongside a compute commitment (nvda-ssi-partnership), is buying ~4.5% of Naver via a ~$1bn share issue tied to a 200MW AI factory (naver-nvda-ai-factory-partnership), and has an exclusive commitment from SpaceX to build its AI infrastructure on NVIDIA platforms (spcx-nvda-starmind-partnership).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Deals investors thought were settled keep being decided in court rather than at closing, and clearing regulators no longer clears the path. Paramount Skydance now has UK CMA approval and clearances in 66 jurisdictions, yet its Warner Bros. Discovery merger still cannot close until five days after a 12-day antitrust trial set for March 2, 2027, with Paramount owing Warner holders ~$7m a day from September 30, 2026 in the meantime (psky-wbd-acquisition). Delaware's Chancery Court has voided Verisk's walk-away from its $2.35bn AccuLynx purchase, ruling the buyer's own willful conduct broke the closing condition and ordering it to try again -- while the FTC review that triggered the termination is still unfinished (vrsk-acculynx-acquisition). InMode's special committee remains procedurally frozen pending the Haifa court's ruling on the competing buyout bids (inmd-steel-partners-buyout).
